en-US.description:
RemoteCrab turns your iPhone or iPad into a camera, microphone, trackpad and keyboard for your computer — over your local WiFi. It also brings your computer's notifications to your phone, and turns your iPad into a real second display. No cloud, no account, no subscription, no analytics. Your video, audio and keystrokes never leave your network.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Your computer's notifications, on your iPhone. A banner arrives on your phone wherever you are — tap it and your computer jumps straight to the app and window that sent it, ready for your next instruction.
• No camera on your desktop computer? A spare iPhone becomes a crisp 1080p webcam — pick "RemoteCrab Camera" in Zoom, Teams, FaceTime or OBS.
• Need more screen? Turn your iPad into a genuine second display and drag windows onto it — no cable, no dongle.
• Long meeting? Control the computer hooked up to your TV from the couch with a full trackpad: drag, two-finger scroll, right-click, three-finger gestures and ⌃⌥⌘⇧ modifiers.
• Microphone too far away or too noisy? Your iPhone is a wireless mic — and hold-to-talk turns your voice into text on the computer.
• Type with the keyboard you already know — full Chinese IME and dictation work — and watch text land at the computer's cursor.

FEATURES
• Notifications: your computer's banners reach your iPhone. Tap one to switch your computer to that app — and that window.
• Camera: 1080p at 30 fps, hardware H.264 encoding. Appears as a standard camera in every computer app after installing the bundled virtual camera component.
• Microphone: real-time streaming; a one-click virtual mic driver makes it available system-wide.
• Second display: extend your desktop onto your iPhone or iPad and drive any window straight from the touch screen.
• Mirror: watch the frontmost app from your phone and tap, drag, scroll and type on it directly.
• Trackpad: smooth acceleration curve, momentum scrolling, drag, pinch, three-finger gestures, haptics.
• Keyboard: system IME, shortcut bar (⌘C ⌘V ⌘Z ⌘⇥), mini trackpad.
• Hold to talk: on-device speech recognition types into the computer.
• Context modes: the shortcut bar follows the app in front of you on the computer — Keynote, Xcode, Finder, browsers, editors and more, plus volume, brightness and media keys.
• App switcher & launcher: bring any running app to the front, or search every installed app and open it.
• Clipboard: send the clipboard either way with one tap.
• Files: send photos & files straight to your computer — they land in Downloads and reveal in Finder.

PRIVACY
RemoteCrab is local-first: no server, no account, no analytics, no in-app purchases, no subscription. Everything stays on your own WiFi.

GETTING STARTED
RemoteCrab requires the free RemoteCrab Receiver for your computer (link inside the app). Open both, they find each other automatically, tap once to pair.
en-US.promotionalText: Your computer's notifications on your iPhone — tap one to jump back to that app and window. Plus camera, mic, trackpad, keyboard and a second display. Local WiFi.
en-US.subtitle: Camera, mic, trackpad & more

zh-Hans.description:
RemoteCrab 把你的 iPhone / iPad 变成 电脑 的摄像头、麦克风、触控板和键盘——全部通过本地 WiFi 直连。它还能把 电脑 的通知送到你手机上，并把 iPad 变成一块真正的第二屏幕。没有云端、没有账号、没有订阅、没有数据分析。你的画面、声音和按键，永远不离开你的局域网。

【这些场景，你可能正需要它】
• 电脑 上的通知，手机上收。通知会像本机通知一样弹在你手机上；点一下，电脑 立刻切回发通知的那个应用和窗口，接着干活。
• 台式 电脑 没有摄像头？旧 iPhone 就是一枚 1080p 高清摄像头，在 Zoom、Teams、FaceTime、OBS 里直接选择「RemoteCrab Camera」。
• 屏幕不够用？把 iPad 变成真正的第二块屏幕，直接把窗口拖过去——不用线材，不用转接器。
• 会议太长？躺在沙发上用完整触控板控制接电视的 电脑：拖动、双指滚动、右键、三指手势、⌃⌥⌘⇧ 修饰键。
• 电脑 麦克风太远太吵？iPhone 就是一支无线麦克风——按住说话，语音还能实时变成 电脑 上的文字。
• 用你最熟悉的输入法打字——中文、听写都支持——文字直接出现在 电脑 光标处。

【功能】
• 通知中继：电脑 上的通知横幅实时送到 iPhone；点一下，电脑 切到对应应用，并把你带到那个窗口。
• 摄像头：1080p 30fps，硬件 H.264 编码；安装随附的虚拟摄像头组件后，在任何 电脑 App 里作为标准摄像头出现。
• 麦克风：实时串流；一键安装虚拟麦克风驱动后全系统可用。
• 扩展显示器：把桌面扩展到 iPhone / iPad，并可在触摸屏上直接操作。
• 投屏：在手机上看 电脑 当前窗口，并直接点按、拖动、滚动、输入。
• 触控板：顺滑加速曲线、惯性滚动、拖拽、双指缩放、三指手势、触觉反馈。
• 键盘：系统输入法、快捷键条（⌘C ⌘V ⌘Z ⌘⇥）、迷你触控板。
• 按住说话：端侧语音识别，说话直接变成 电脑 上的文字。
• 情景模式：快捷键条会跟着 电脑 前台应用自动切换——Keynote、Xcode、访达、浏览器、编辑器等，还有音量、亮度、媒体键。
• App 切换与启动：点一下切到某个应用，或搜索并打开 电脑 上任何已安装的应用。
• 剪贴板：两端剪贴板一键互发。
• 文件：照片和文件直发 电脑，自动存入下载文件夹并在访达中显示。

【隐私】
RemoteCrab 是纯本地应用：不跑服务器、不需要账号、不收集任何数据、没有内购和订阅。一切都在你自己的 WiFi 里。

【开始使用】
需要搭配免费的 电脑 端 RemoteCrab Receiver（App 内有获取链接）。两端打开后自动发现，点一下即可配对。
